title: Figure 3: Orion HPM Testing Facility – containerized test system with antenna
description: Black-and-white photograph of the Orion system, a transportable high-power microwave test facility housed in shipping containers, with a parabolic antenna on top, set outdoors. The caption reads "Figure 3. Orion HPM Testing Facility." The text says the system, first fielded in 1995, uses four tunable magnetrons (1 to 3.3 GHz); the page also covers gyrotrons.
